description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValueDao interface, which extends a generic DAO for CustomerOptionValue entities, providing methods for retrieving customer option values by store and language, as well as by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDao
classes.description: Interface for data access object handling CustomerOptionValue entities, with methods to query customer option values by store, language, and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerOptionValue objects associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue by its code within a specified store.
